_doc: Demo49 thermal plan (DUAL), real sources only. Timeline-ish but interaction-driven; build stage drives it.

@fan_on.why: the oscillating fan: cool air sweeping LEFT ↔ RIGHT every 4 s (moving source), heat felt less where it blows

@bottle.why: the towel-wrapped ice-water bottle right in front of your face

@naomi_cheek.why: Naomi's warm cheek against your right side

@uchiwa.why: you fan yourself: gentle cool puffs, front

@rain_open.why: rain air blowing in at the LEFT window (if left open)

@rain_closed.why: window shut: no wind, muggy again

@squeeze.why: startled by thunder, Naomi squeezes against your LEFT side

@shoulder.why: night: Naomi on your shoulder, purring at your LEFT ear; the fan on low sweeps the right

showcase.fast_switch: the fan's sweep passing an ear in the heat: warm-only → cool-dominant → warm again every 2 s
showcase.peak: ice bottle + fan full speed in front
showcase.direction: fan sweep left ↔ right; rain from the left window; Naomi left / right
showcase.same_ear_dual: heat + fan on each ear; at night Naomi warm left ear + fan cool passing
